title: Q-learning
summary: Christopher J. C. H. Watkins and Peter Dayan published Q-learning in Machine Learning in May 1992. The paper describes Q-learning as an incremental dynamic-programming method for agents to improve action-value estimates and presents a detailed convergence theorem for the method under stated conditions.
significance: A documented reinforcement-learning milestone providing a formal published treatment and convergence result for Q-learning while explicitly identifying the method as originating in Watkins's earlier 1989 work.
